'''Kebabs''' are a camel meat delicacy which can be purchased in [[Al Kharid]] and [[Keldagrim]]-East for 1 coin each, or at [[Pollnivneach]] for 3 coins each. The [[Drunken Dwarf]], [[Mysterious Old Man]], [[Sandwich Lady]], and [[Rick Turpentine]] random events may also grant the player a free kebab.

Unlike normal food which restores a fixed amount of [[Hitpoints]], kebabs have varied healing quantities when consumed. A player with 86–99 Hitpoints can expect to be healed 11 health on average.

Kebabs '''cannot''' be made through the [[Cooking]] skill. They can be used on a [[compost bin]] to make regular [[compost]].

== Average healing ==
The average amount healed by a kebab is given by the formula:

<math>\frac{1}{32} \left \lfloor 7+x\cdot\frac{6}{25} \right \rfloor + \frac{1}{4} \left \lfloor 6+x\cdot\frac{7}{50} \right \rfloor + \frac{5}{8}\left \lfloor 3+x\cdot\frac{7}{100} \right \rfloor</math>

Where 𝑥 is the [[Hitpoints]] level of the player

==Trivia==
*It is implied that the kebabs are made from camel meat.
**[[Ali the Camel Man]] in [[Pollnivneach]] reveals about his discount camel store that "They're not just a source of kebab meat you know!"
**When using the "Talk-to Camel", the player character can quote "Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab."
*Eating kebabs is the only method of [[Temporary skill boost|temporarily boosting]] one's Attack level in a free-to-play server (albeit very rarely).
*Kebabs originally had a chance of dealing damage to the player's hitpoints as an adverse effect; however, this feature was removed to prevent players from being killed inadvertently.
*Kebabs in ''Old School RuneScape'' are specifically based on the real-life [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doner_kebab doner kebab], originating from Turkey, sometimes stuffed into [[pitta bread]] as with the player-made [[ugthanki kebab]], and a popular street food in the United Kingdom, where the [[Jagex]] office is based.
